defs.def:first-stage-ratio-contract: \(\mathcal E_N^{\infty}(b_N)=\{\max_{i\in[n]}\|\log\widehat R_i-\log R_i\|_{C^1(K)}\le b_N\}\), with the contract \(\inf_{\theta\in\Theta^{\beta}_{G,s}(c,M,K,\rho)}\Pr_\theta\{\mathcal E_N^{\infty}(b_N)\}\ge1-\eta_N\).
defs.def:generated-rank-handle: Adapt Xie's local-linear conditional-CDF estimator to cross-fitted log-ratio responses and covariates; decompose the second stage into the oracle conditional-CDF process, indicator boundary crossings from the generated threshold, and local-design perturbations from generated conditioning arguments, then linearize the last component with the generated-covariate expansion of Mammen, Rothe, and Schienle.
